sourceEvidence.source: User-supplied Geometry 10 basic-level Merzlyak et al., 2022, 5th stereotyped edition
sourceEvidence.method: Read every exercise statement and diagram from page renders, compared all authored statements and source subparts, and checked solutions independently. OCR was an aid; page renders were the authority. Source PDF and raw OCR are excluded.

reviewMethods: Read all 83 statements, hints and step sequences; checked all source subparts and the distinction between a pictured example, a universal statement and a counterexample.

Independently derived the odd-midpoint proof in 1.25, common-point and common-plane arguments in paragraph 2, construction traces in paragraph 3, the seven-cube counterexample in 3.28 and impossibility proof in 3.30.
Checked finite coordinates, incidence, collinearity, coplanarity, nondegeneracy, source metric constraints and auxiliary intersections.
Computed each of 19 plane cuts independently from all primary solid edges, checked every intended corner, adjacent face membership and consistent convex boundary order.
Re-read final construction-view edits and reran numeric checks after the final author changes.

limitations: This report covers the listed 83 draft cards only. The chapter also has supplemental and other activities and is not certified complete.
Numerical tests establish authored model constraints, not universal geometric theorems. General arguments were reviewed separately in the step text.
Illustrative coordinates are schematic. Source diagrams are preserved by incidence and relative position rather than exact pixel measurement.
This is independent internal content review, not external provider approval, owner approval, or permission to merge or publish.
The reviewer did not change lesson status or review fields; they remained draft/pending at the recorded hashes.
